description: This file defines the CommonEncryptionData class used for parsing and managing content encryption keys and related data in a media DRM context. It includes methods for parsing PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON init data, and manages key IDs and their associated system types.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData
classes.description: A class for parsing and managing encryption key data, including PSSH, XML, and JSON formats, for DRM systems.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData::KeyId
classes.description: A subclass of OCDM::KeyId that includes system type flags and methods for comparison and flagging.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::CommonEncryptionData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing provided data buffer.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Status
methods.description: Returns the current key status, or pending if no keys.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Status(const KeyId&)
methods.description: Returns the key status for a specific key ID.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the stored key IDs.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::HasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a specific key ID is present.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::AddKeyId
methods.description: Adds or updates a key ID in the collection.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::UpdateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific key ID.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current keys support another set of keys.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no keys stored.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Parse
methods.description: Parses the input data buffer for PSSH, XML, or JSON data.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParsePSSHBox
methods.description: Parses a PSSH box to extract key IDs based on system type.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::FindInXML
methods.description: Finds a substring within XML data, considering UTF-16 encoding.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseXMLBox
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract key IDs from PlayReady headers.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseJSONInitData
methods.description: Parses JSON init data to extract key IDs.
